en: A vintage, sepia-toned postcard showing a wide, tree-lined street with people walking and a tram or streetcar visible on the right. On the left, a large building with the word 'HOTEL' visible on its roof can be seen partially obscured by trees. The setting is urban, with a tranquil, historical ambiance. The text 'Nijmegen' and 'Spoorstraat' are printed on the postcard, indicating the location and street name.
